title: GPT-6.2 Astra or GPT-6.2 Sol: what each costs and what OpenAI says you get
intro: Switch between the two new models to see their API prices per million tokens and the one headline result OpenAI gives for each. Both can also run in the new background window at a discount.
note: Prices are OpenAI’s standard API rates per million tokens, as listed on 17 November 2026. The benchmark results are OpenAI’s own and describe cost per task, not price per token. The background discounts apply to the Responses API public beta, set against standard rates. ChatGPT plan users are not billed per token.
